title: US Newspapers Dropped From 7,325 To 4,490
hook: Thousands of US newspapers vanished, and local accountability went with them.
closing: Without local newspapers, decisions affecting your town face less scrutiny.
question: Who covers your town?

segments.say: Since 2005, the US lost nearly 3,000 newspapers—about two in five in twenty years. Local accountability vanished with them.
In one year, four more counties lost all local news, bringing newspaper deserts to 208. Decisions there now get less scrutiny.
Fifteen percent of the country has little or no newspaper coverage, leaving millions without regular reporting on local power.
